en.html:
護氏"...Then, Your Highness Prince Maidono. I shall now proceed to Hachimangu for the sword-offering rite."
護氏"May I entrust Fudaraku in my absence to you, together with the reception of Lord Kujou, the imperial offerings envoy."
舞殿宮"Ah, yes. You also take care of your side, Commander of the Six GuardsRikufu."
護氏"Indeed. I shall pray for a hundred years of prosperity for the nation."
舞殿宮"A fine thing to pray for, certainly."
護氏"Forgive the presumption, but I have taken upon myself the duty of supporting our divine land of Yamato. In any service to the nation, however small, you will not find me neglectful."
舞殿宮"...Yes, I understand. Your wholehearted loyalty, Rikufu—I understand it very well."
護氏"Your words honor me."
護氏"Then, without delay, permit me to discharge one such duty here in Your Highness's presence. An unpleasant business, but duty does not consult our pleasure."
舞殿宮"...What was that?"
護氏"Raichou."
Raichou"Yes, Father."

護氏 「……然らば、舞殿宮殿下。 　これより太刀奉納の儀のため八幡宮へ赴き ますゆえ」
護氏 「普陀楽の留守と奉幣使九条殿の饗応、何卒 宜しくお頼み申します」
舞殿宮 「あぁ、うん。 　そっちも宜しゅうにな、六府りくふ」
護氏 「はっ。 　国家百年の繁栄を祈願して参りましょう」
舞殿宮 「そらええことやなァ」
護氏 「憚りながらこの六府、神州大和の大黒柱を 自ら任じてござれば…… 　国家のためのいかなる務めであろうと怠る つもりは毛頭ございませぬ」
舞殿宮 「……あぁ、ようわかってる。 　六府の赤心忠義は、ようくわかってますえ」
護氏 「畏れ入ります」
護氏 「されば早速、これより宮殿下の御前を拝借 して、我が務めの一つを果たしましょうぞ。 　楽しからぬ仕儀なれど、是非もなし」
舞殿宮 「……なんやて？」
護氏 「雷蝶」
雷蝶 「はい、お父様」

en.html:
ｅｔｃ／側近金子"Y... Your Highness..."
舞殿宮"Kaneko!? How have you come to be here...?"
舞殿宮"What is the meaning of this, Rikufu!"
護氏"...Indeed. Your Highness can know nothing of it."
護氏"Though employed in Your Highness's closest service, this man joined the remnants of the rebel Okabe. Worse still, the insolent wretch was plotting to draw Your Highness into their treason!"
舞殿宮"————"
ｅｔｃ／側近金子"..."
護氏"A thunderbolt from a clear sky for Your Highness, no doubt. But the material evidence is already in our hands. There is no room left for doubting the facts—"
護氏"Your distress is entirely understandable."
舞殿宮"..."
Raichou"Oh? Your Highness Prince Maidono does not appear so very surprised."
Raichou"Could it be that you knew all along... perhaps?"
舞殿宮"N-no..."
護氏"Do not talk nonsense, Raichou. A personage of His Highness's standing, knowingly keeping a traitor beside him? Such a thing is not possible."
護氏"...Is that not so, Your Highness?"
舞殿宮"............"
Raichou"Uf... fufufu..."
ｅｔｃ／側近金子"His Highness has nothing to do with it! He knows nothing! I was probing to see whether he wished to overthrow the shogunate, but achieved nothing before being reduced to this...!"
ｅｔｃ／側近金子"Bitter though it is to admit, Prince Maidono is the useless ornament people say he is! His hands are clean! Take my head and finish—"
Raichou"You will keep quiet, please."

ｅｔｃ／側近金子 「み……宮殿下……」
舞殿宮 「金子!? 　おまさんがどうしてここに……」
舞殿宮 「これはどういうことや、六府！」
護氏 「……左様……。 　宮殿下は何もご存知ありますまい」
護氏 「この者、宮殿下のお側近くに仕える用人で ありながら、逆賊岡部の残党どもと結び…… 　あろうことか、宮殿下を謀反の企みに引き 入れようとまで図っていた不逞の輩！」
舞殿宮 「――――」
ｅｔｃ／側近金子 「……」
護氏 「宮殿下には晴天の霹靂でございましょう。 　しかし、これは既に物証もあがり、事実を 疑う余地は無し――」
護氏 「ご心中、お察し申し上げます」
舞殿宮 「……」
雷蝶 「あらぁ？ 　舞殿宮殿下、あまり驚いておられませんの ねぇ」
雷蝶 「もしかして、とっくにご存知でいらっしゃ った……とか？」
舞殿宮 「い、いや……」
護氏 「戯けたことを申すな、雷蝶。 　舞殿宮殿下ともあろう御方が、逆賊をそれ と承知で側へ置いておかれる筈がない」
護氏 「……左様でございますな？ 　宮殿下」
舞殿宮 「…………」
雷蝶 「ウフ、フフフッ……」
ｅｔｃ／側近金子 「宮殿下は無関係だ！　何もご存知ない！ 　私は宮殿下に倒幕のご意思がお有りか否か 探っていたが、何の成果もなく、このような 始末となった……！」
ｅｔｃ／側近金子 「無念だが、舞殿宮殿下は風聞通りの昼行灯、 潔白であられる！ 　さっさと私の首を――」
雷蝶 「お黙りなさいな」

舞殿宮"Kaneko!"
護氏"Your Highness. What is your answer?"
護氏"If Your Highness knew this man's true character... then I cannot avoid asking why you kept such a person at your side."

護氏"...Then, Your Highness. You have no objection to leaving this man's disposal entirely to us?"
舞殿宮"Ah... none. Do as you please with him."
護氏"Very good. Raichou, take him away."
Raichou"Yes."

en.html:
護氏"...Such is always the end of traitors. A comforting thing, to see justice in this world properly maintained."
舞殿宮"...Yes."
護氏"We shall soon round up Okabe's surviving failures, every last one, and send them after him. Please await that news without anxiety."
舞殿宮"..."
護氏"It is a sincere relief to learn that Your Highness had no part in so contemptible a treason. You understand the order of things so well; naturally, I never entertained any suspicion—"
護氏"May you continue to conduct yourself correctly."
舞殿宮"I understand..."
護氏"Thanks to you, I can perform the sword-offering rite with a clear mind. Then... I take my leave."
舞殿宮"..."
護氏"Your Highness."
舞殿宮"What is it?"
護氏"The color of the sala flowers declares that the prosperous must decline. Even the age of the arrogant is no more than a dream on a spring night."
護氏"—You might repeat that to yourself, and wait patiently. Rokuhara is not narrow-minded. So long as Your Highness enjoys his dreams inside his own head, we have no intention of finding fault."
舞殿宮"............"
護氏"Kukukuku... Kahahahahahahahaha!"
